body.title: Add the guarded entry-point inventory and refusal output tests
body.summary: Add a test that lists the guarded entry points (the workflow-step phases, the workflow driver, the build-step phases, approveArtifactByJsonPath, approveWorkflowTarget, the apply branch of resolveReviewFinding and both review fix sites) and checks each calls the gate or the review-fix decision, and that the analyze and code-review steps do not, and a terminal output test for the approve, resolve, claim and release refusals.
acceptanceChecks: Removing a gate call from any listed entry point fails the inventory test
Analyze and code-review steps are not on the inventory

tests.name: src/workflow/__tests__/gate-guarded-entry-points.test.ts: the inventory of guarded entry points (daemon step phases, approveArtifactByJsonPath, approveWorkflowTarget, resolveReviewFinding apply) is complete, and the analyze and code-review steps are not on it
src/cli/__tests__/gate-refusal-output.test.ts: the terminal approve and resolve commands print the refusal naming the holder, formatted beside the review-block message
